name: codex-opencode-adapter
description: Adapter service that translates codex app-server JSON-RPC to OpenCode HTTP/SSE API

scripts.package: npm run compile && mkdir -p dist/package && cp dist/codex-opencode-adapter dist/package/ && cp scripts/start.sh dist/package/ && chmod +x dist/package/start.sh && cd dist/package && tar czf ../codex-opencode-adapter-$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')-$(uname -m).tar.gz *
scripts.package:macos-arm64: npm run compile && mkdir -p dist/package && cp dist/codex-opencode-adapter dist/package/ && cp scripts/start.sh dist/package/ && chmod +x dist/package/start.sh && cd dist/package && tar czf ../codex-opencode-adapter-darwin-arm64.tar.gz *
scripts.package:macos-x64: npm run compile && mkdir -p dist/package && cp dist/codex-opencode-adapter dist/package/ && cp scripts/start.sh dist/package/ && chmod +x dist/package/start.sh && cd dist/package && tar czf ../codex-opencode-adapter-darwin-x64.tar.gz *
